title: Build Recovery Workbench panel
purpose: Turn recovery from a report into a focused workflow for interrupted, degraded or rollback-pending runs.
scope: Render recoverable runs grouped by safe-to-verify, needs-rollback, needs-human-review and failed-closed.
Show recovery source as run-store plus audit-journal.
Render safe next commands through typed grammar.
Keep recovery state derived from RunStore and AuditJournal.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery actions never trigger model replay.
Rollback-pending state cannot be hidden by healthy dashboard summary.
Human review state includes clear next action and audit reference.
failure_modes: Recovery panel uses synthetic render cache as truth.
Recovery command triggers replanning or model replay.
Rollback-pending effect is rendered as completed.
